findings.title: Three Palestinians killed in Israeli strike on Gaza University
findings.location: Islamic University campus, Gaza City, Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_system: Three people reportedly killed (Sami Baroud, Ashraf Dahlan, Shadi Abu Ataya), other persons wounded; an earlier reported strike at the campus wounded five people. Student and university campus safety.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Three Palestinians were killed and others injured on Sunday in a second Israeli airstrike targeting the Islamic University campus in Gaza City.
findings.source_type: News agency reporting; corroborated by Palestinian news agency WAFA; attribution is reported, not independently investigated
findings.confidence: medium-high for occurrence as reported by multiple outlets; event minute unverified

bounded_discovery_context.timing_caveat: WAFA's reporting time (05:18 PDT) predates the start of this watch's window, but its newly surfaced report was absent from the previously recorded WAFA latest-news listing. SABA's direct report at 05:55 PDT is in-window. The attack's exact time is unknown; do not claim it occurred in this window.
bounded_discovery_context.cross_report_deduplication: This campus report is included within WAFA's seven-Gaza-fatality daily aggregate, and is not seven additional fatalities. The 12:01 WAFA report concerned al-Mawasi, Hamad Hospital area, and al-Rashid road, not the campus. No October 25 edition is listed in the publicly visible Gaza archive at observation.
